component.name: Filefind
component.summary: Find any file by what's inside it

description.p: Filefind searches the text inside your documents. Add the folders you want to search and start typing: results appear as you type, even with typos.

ul.li: Searches inside PDF, Word, LibreOffice, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, EPUB, HTML, Markdown and text files
Finds words even with typos or missing accents
Notices when files are added or changed
Preview files with every match highlighted
Results also appear in GNOME and KDE system search

screenshot.caption: Search results with highlighted matches and a preview
Spreadsheets and CSV files as tables

ul.li: Full-text search inside PDF, Word, LibreOffice, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, EPUB, HTML, Markdown, text and code, tolerant of typos and of other word forms in English and Spanish
Photos, music and other files are found by name
Filters by type and date, sorting, and a search syntax for phrases, exclusions, type:, in: and name:
Quick preview with highlighted matches: code with syntax highlighting, spreadsheets and CSV files as tables, formatted Markdown and web pages
Choose which folders to search, with or without subfolders, and exclude folders or name patterns
Results in GNOME and KDE system search
Indexing follows changes to your files and only runs when your computer is idle
